title: 第13章 我肯定是正道修士啊第14章 地道糕手
slug: 道爷斗法累了西幻炸个鱼怎么了
lines: “刚才这门不是还关着吗？老三你怎么检查的？”
“我不到啊！
大哥，我刚刚专门推拉过门了，真打不开！”
干瘦的年轻人连忙解释道。
“妈了个巴子的这现在怎么办”
那独眼壮汉掏出一把满是锈铁的匕首，对准了陈昭。
“呵呵，好办好办”
见来者这三人身上的气势和凡人无异，陈昭笑呵呵的关上了门，将那穿过正门洒进来的阳光遮掩。
没了外来的光照，在顶上吊灯的映照下，气氛显得沉重起来。
“诸位可否告诉我，这店主如今何方去了呢？”
随手洒下几枚铜币，陈昭抚摸着手里的缚灵鞭，用可能发音有些奇怪的本地语言询问道。
“屮，是那小娘皮的同伙，砍他！”
匪徒大喝一声，提着武器就冲来，那先前表现懦弱的大汉反倒最为勇猛，拎着斧头冲在最前面。
陈昭轻笑一声，甩手就是一鞭抽在那持斧大汉的胸口，将他击飞，砸在墙上，随后摔落下来。
其余二人定睛一看，只见那持斧壮汉的胸口已经塌陷下去，显然活不了了。
“二弟！
“唉，真是罪过，罪过呀。”
摇着头，陈昭装出一副懊悔的神情
“不过是问些事情而已，没想到对方如此冲动，天道你明鉴，一定要明鉴啊！
我这算是正当防卫，你看我阻止对方继续行凶后就停手了，标准的正当防卫流程！
可莫要扣我功德些……”
嘴上是这般在说，陈昭心理想的却是这凡人身体有些坚韧，虽然陈昭也没动用灵气，可吃了缚灵鞭一击鞭打后竟只是胸口塌陷，而不是凌空被打爆，这结实程度有些超出预期了。
嗯？天道真明鉴了？
陈昭冥冥之中感觉，自己的功德不但没有降低，反而稍稍往上涨了一分。
是错觉吗？
回味间，那独眼壮汉便是浑身散发着斗气，挥舞匕首扑了上来。
先前在旅馆时，陈昭也瞥见过巡逻的卫兵用斗气激发力量捉拿盗贼，如今再见也不会太过惊讶，无非就是气血的劣等版本而已，充其量有锻体期入门的水准吧。
反手一鞭将独眼壮汉抽飞，陈昭打了个哈欠。
比起先前被筑基期修士追杀，面见金丹期修士，如今这点水平，着实难以带给陈昭压力。
唉，无聊的虐菜。
那壮汉倒是眼疾手快，用匕首格挡了一下，可缚灵鞭的威力太大，直将其抽飞到天花板上，撞的那吊灯颤抖起来，光影摇晃。
“老大！
你没事吧…老大？”
瘦小的强盗见没有回应，转头看去，却看那独眼壮汉原来已经脖子折断，当场毙命了。
“啊啊啊啊！
火球术！
content_en:
"Isn't this door still closed just now? How did you check it, third brother?"
“I can’t come!
Brother, I just pushed and pulled the door, and it really couldn't be opened! "
The skinny young man explained quickly.
"What should I do now?"
The one-eyed man took out a rusty dagger and pointed it at Chen Zhao.
"Haha, it's easy to handle."
Seeing that the aura of the three people who came was no different from ordinary people, Chen Zhao smiled and closed the door, blocking the sunlight that poured in through the main door.
Without the external light, the atmosphere seemed heavy under the light of the chandeliers overhead.
"Can you tell me where the shop owner is now?"
After scattering a few copper coins casually, Chen Zhao stroked the spirit-binding whip in his hand and asked in the local language which may have a strange pronunciation.
"Hey, he's that little bitch's accomplice, kill him!"
The gangsters shouted loudly and rushed over with weapons in hand. The big man who had been cowardly before turned out to be the bravest and rushed at the front with an ax in hand.
Chen Zhao chuckled lightly, then whipped his hand and whipped the axe-wielding man on the chest, knocking him away, smashing him against the wall, and then he fell down.
The other two took a closer look and saw that the chest of the strong man holding the ax had collapsed, and it was obvious that he would not survive.
"Second brother!
! "
"Oh, what a sin, what a sin."
Shaking his head, Chen Zhao pretended to look remorseful.
"I'm just asking about some things. I didn't expect the other party to be so impulsive. God knows how to deal with this. You must learn from it!"
This is considered self-defense. You see, I stopped after preventing the other party from continuing to attack. It is a standard self-defense procedure!
But don’t try to deduct any merit from me…”
What Chen Zhao said was that this mortal's body was somewhat tough. Although Chen Zhao didn't use his spiritual energy, after being hit by the spirit-binding whip, his chest collapsed instead of being blown up in the air. This strength was beyond expectations.
Um? Is the way of heaven really clear?
Chen Zhao secretly felt that instead of decreasing, his merit had increased slightly.
Is it an illusion?
After thinking about it, the one-eyed man was exuding fighting spirit and rushed forward with a dagger.
When he was in the hotel before, Chen Zhao also caught a glimpse of the patrolling guards using their fighting spirit to inspire their strength to capture the thieves. Now he would not be too surprised to see them again. They were nothing more than inferior versions of their qi and blood. At best, they were at the entry level of the body training stage.
Chen Zhao yawned as he whipped the one-eyed man away with a backhand whip.
Compared to the previous days when he was hunted down by monks at the foundation-building stage and met with monks at the golden elixir stage, it was really difficult to put pressure on Chen Zhao at this level.
Oh, what a boring piece of shit.
The strong man had quick eyesight and quick hands, and blocked it with a dagger, but the power of the spirit-binding whip was too great, and it flew to the ceiling, causing the chandelier to tremble and the light and shadow to shake.
"Boss!
Are you okay...boss? "
Seeing no response, the skinny robber turned around and saw that the one-eyed man's neck had been broken and he was killed on the spot.
“Ahhhhh!
Fireball!
